Title: Evidence rule (mandatory)
Text: For every ⚠️ or ❌: - Provide **one short excerpt** (≤ 25 words) from the file and location: `{filename — section heading}`   - Provide the **canonical requirement** excerpt (≤ 25 words) and location: `{AGENT_HELPS_HUMANS.md — section heading}`   - Provide a **conformance fix** (specific edit instruction; minimal change preferred)
